author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Send the info-center logs and the syslog session logs (default format, not MTN, NetFlow or a custom template) to the data collector; the README has the commands. Policy permit and deny logs, SECLOG session builds, teardowns and drop records go to Netflow (deny, drop and policy-deny closes as blocked); IPS detect, botnet, trojan, worm and domain logs and WAF logs to NIDS; AV virus and file reputation logs to Antivirus; URL filtering to HTTP; SSL VPN and web UI sign-ins, failures and sign-outs to Auth; security policy rule changes to Management Event. Other messages of the POLICY, SECLOG, IPS, AV, URL, WAF, SSLVPN and WEBM modules stay generic. CLI and SSH sign-ins and command records are the same VRP messages on every Huawei device, so the Huawei VRP switches and routers entry reads them; add both for full coverage. The time is read with its zone (date, format-date, rfc-3339 and short-date); without-timezone times are read as UTC. How sure this is: the message templates and parameter values come from Huawei's HiSecEngine USG6000F V600R025C10 Log Reference, whose pages open only in a browser. Huawei shows no syslog session log line with its header, so the parser expects the info-center header its Log Reference describes; that part is inferred. Huawei doesn't document the format of BeginTime, EndTime or the policy log's time, so they are kept as sent (session times in event_metadata), and a protocol is read as a number or a name. Samples are made up from the templates. The parsers passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-16: each child combined with the parent into one parser (294 of 294 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and each child as a separate parser under its parent (290 of 290 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs, and the parent-only line matched). No built-in parser claimed these lines in 3 runs. In Sophos NG-SIEM, SPLIT_NAME_VALUES adds an item that has no key to the value before it, so the drop record's reason would join the destination zone; the parser reads that zone from the text.
